author: adamdangelo
text: We are launching an API for Poe today. Poe accounts can now be used to power Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, and anything else you or others build. All models and bots can be accessed via the API, and you can purchase points at cost to go beyond subscription limits. See thread below.

quoted.text:
Introducing the Poe API for developers, with three important features:

1) Access to all models and bots on Poe across all modalities
2) A standard OpenAI-compatible chat completions interface
3) The ability to purchase points beyond subscription limits 🧵 https://t.co/Gj2zujm0WM

author: adamdangelo
text: At Quora we recently tested switching from Zoom to Google Meet for a week. Google Meet is better in many small ways, but worse in one big way: audio quality, particularly background noise cancellation and echoing. That kills it so we are staying on Zoom!
